initialExam.title: RRB NTPC (Under Graduate / 12th Level) 2026
initialExam.description: Non-Technical Popular Categories for 12th level posts including Commercial Clerk, Trains Clerk, etc. CBT-1 ongoing 7 May - 20 Jun 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: CBT-1: Mathematics (30Q), Reasoning (30Q), General Awareness (40Q). CBT-2: Same subjects at 12th level.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT-1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 min. CBT-2: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 min.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → Typing/Skill Test → Document Verification → Medical
initialExam.jobRole: Commercial Clerk, Trains Clerk, Junior Account Assistant, Senior Time Keeper
initialExam.careerGrowth: Clerk → Head Clerk → Chief Clerk through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Free Rail passes, Medical, Pension
